product.name: Ener-J HygienePro White Smart Toilet with Integrated Tank, Heated Seat, Warm Water Bidet & Dryer
product.description:
Upgrade your bathroom with the Ener-J HygienePro Smart Toilet, an all-in-one design that combines a modern, tankless look with advanced hygiene and comfort technology. The integrated tank removes the need for a separate cistern, giving you a clean, compact profile (680 x 400 x 475 mm) that suits contemporary bathrooms and en-suites. It works with water pressure from just 0.06 MPa, so it performs reliably in most homes.

The built-in bidet heats water instantly as you use it, so there's no waiting and no stored hot water. You can choose from female, hip, massage, moving spray and baby wash modes. Water, seat and dryer temperatures each have four settings (ambient, 34°C, 37°C or 40°C), and the spray position moves forward and backward for a precise, personalised clean. Afterwards, the warm air dryer offers a hands-free, paper-saving finish.

Hygiene is built into every detail. The nozzle cleans itself automatically, UV sterilisation adds extra protection, and the antibacterial seat and anti-fouling ceramic glaze help keep the bowl cleaner for longer. A foam shield reduces splashing, and the dual filtration system protects the water supply.

Control is effortless. You can use voice commands, the included remote, the one-touch side knob or the foot sensors, which open the lid and seat and flush without contact. The automatic lid opens as you approach, and the soft-close seat and lid shut quietly. The power failure flushing function means the toilet still flushes during a power cut.

For extra relaxation, the toilet includes built-in aromatherapy, music playback and 256-colour ambient mood lighting, plus a soft night light for late-night visits. An energy-saving mode and leakage protection add everyday peace of mind.

product.name: AquaECO Submersible Pond Pump 4500 L/H
product.description:
The new AquaECO series of pond pumps from All Pond Solutions with its brand new innovative electronics brings massive energy savings, low noise, and long durability while maintaining high performance.Compared to other pond pump brands the wattage use of the AquaECO range of pond pumps is extremely economical, saving you money in the long run.

Ultra Low Wattage:
* AquaECO-4500 (4500L/H) = 30w

Designed to circulate water to a pond filter or waterfall, the AquaECO cage is specially designed to tolerate particles of dirt/ debris up to 6-8mm and prevent clogging by providing the maximum surface area for drawing water in through the guard to the pump.

Included with the AquaECO pump is an additional inlet that allows you to attach a hose to the inlet of the pump to provide water directly from a source such as a pond skimmer.Operational mode 1:

Designed to be placed straight into your pond, the AquaECO will simply draw water directly in through the filter cage, through the pump, and out of the directional hosetail outlet.Operational mode 2:

By attaching the included hosetail inlet to the front of the pump, you can direct an alternative water source (such as a pond skimmer) directly into the front of the pump.The inlet and outlet hosetail adaptors' direction can be adjusted by slightly unscrewing the blue hosetail nut, adjusting the angle to your requirements, and then re-tightening the hosetail nut.The filter cage is secured using four strong clips which allow for easy tool-free access to your pump and impeller area.The cage design incorporates a convenient handle meaning the AquaECO pump can be removed from your pond easily, avoiding potential damage by pulling the power cable to retrieve the pump.

Specifications
Flow rate: 4500L/h
Height Max: 400cm

product.name: AutoSiliconeHoses Straight Reinforced Hose High-Temp High Pressure for Turbo Water Intercooler Coolant Radiator (Blue - 850mm)
product.description: Our Silicone Straight Joiner Couplers (SSC) offer a high-performance solution for connecting pipes in coolant, air, water, and turbo systems. Designed to perform under pressure—literally and figuratively.

product.name: SunDaze 4 x 3m Manual Awning Garden Patio Canopy Sun Shade Shelter Retractable with Fittings and Crank Handle Wine Red
product.description:
4 x 3m Wine Red Patio Manual Awning
With Steel Square Torsion Bar and Aluminium roller, more durable than other seller,no torsion bar awning.
With two heavy duty cables in the center joint of arms makes it easier to project and retract.
Side covers on the roller support makes your awning elegant looking.
The specially designed aluminium arms are adjustable to enable you to alter the slope of the awning from 5 degrees to a relatively steep tilt of approximately 35 degrees from the horizontal.
Retractable, can be opened as much or as little as you like up to the maximum projection.
Steel crank handle is on the left as you face the awning (same as shown in picture), and can not be moved to another side.

Aluminium front bar: 47.2x35.6x1.2mm.
Aluminium support arm: 47x28x1.2mm, 37x20x1.2mm.
Fabric material: PU coated water-resistant 300g/m2 polyester fabric.

1. All products have been checked before shipping.

product.name: Invena 1/2 Inch Inline Ball Valve Female Thread For Water With Drain Valve
product.description: A ball valve is a valve with a spherical disc, the part of the valve which controls the flow through it. The sphere has a hole, or port, through the middle so that when the port is in line with both ends of the valve, flow will occur. When the valve is closed, the hole is perpendicular to the ends of the valve, and flow is blocked. The handle or lever will be inline with the port position letting you "see" the valve's position. The ball valve, along with the butterfly valve and plug valve, are part of the family of quarter turn valves.  Ball valves are durable and usually work to achieve perfect shutoff even after years of disuse. They are therefore an excellent choice for shutoff applications (and are often preferred to globe valves and gate valves for this purpose). They do not offer the fine control that may be necessary in throttling applications but are sometimes used for this purpose. product.name: Invena 3/4 Inch Inline Ball Valve Female Thread For Water With Drain Valve
product.description: A ball valve is a valve with a spherical disc, the part of the valve which controls the flow through it. The sphere has a hole, or port, through the middle so that when the port is in line with both ends of the valve, flow will occur. When the valve is closed, the hole is perpendicular to the ends of the valve, and flow is blocked. The handle or lever will be inline with the port position letting you "see" the valve's position. The ball valve, along with the butterfly valve and plug valve, are part of the family of quarter turn valves.  Ball valves are durable and usually work to achieve perfect shutoff even after years of disuse. They are therefore an excellent choice for shutoff applications (and are often preferred to globe valves and gate valves for this purpose). They do not offer the fine control that may be necessary in throttling applications but are sometimes used for this purpose. product.name: Hoses UK 45mm Black PVC Corrugated Flexible Water Butt Hose 5m Reinforced Downpipe Connector Rainwater Harvesting Pump Pond
product.description: The Hoses UK Black PVC Corrugated Water Butt & Pond Hose is a high-quality, flexible hose designed for connecting water butts, downpipes, and ponds. Its solid black wall helps prevent algae growth in outdoor systems, making it an ideal choice for rainwater harvesting and pond circulation applications. Made from smooth PVC inner layer with UV-resistant corrugated PVC outer wall, this hose features high-tensile plastic rib reinforcement to provide durability and crush resistance while maintaining flexibility. Operating within the temperature range of -10 degrees C to +65 degrees C (peak +70 degrees C), this hose is compliant with BS EN ISO 3994-2001 standards and offers reliable performance across repeated use. Its transparent construction allows operators to monitor flow and detect blockages or contamination quickly, making it particularly useful in pond systems, aquatics, and industrial water circulation. Typical applications include pond and aquarium circulation, garden water features, drainage systems, irrigation setups, light industrial fluid handling tasks, workshop water transfer, and light chemical solutions where visibility and flexible installation are essential.

product.name: Thermopanel Offset Black Square Drain Wet Room Shower Tray Former and Tanking Kit - Squares Grate - 1200 x 1000 x 20mm
product.description:
The Thermopanel Square Offset Drain Shower Tray Former is the perfect all-in-one solution for creating a sleek, flush walk-in shower or wet room. Unlike bulky acrylic trays, it provides a seamless, tile-ready base that integrates beautifully with your bathroom floor. Lightweight yet incredibly strong, it features a pre-formed 2% gradient for rapid drainage and is coated with a cementitious layer that’s ready for tiling with ceramic, porcelain, mosaics, or natural stone.

This versatile tray is available in 20 mm and 25 mm depths and can be trimmed by up to 50 mm from each edge (equal cuts required), making it ideal for custom installations. It includes a offset-positioned square drain with a high-performance waste and a choice of three stylish grate designs—Leaf, Tile, or Square—in Black, Gold, or Stainless Steel finishes. To complete your waterproofing system, a full tanking kit is also included. Compatible with timber and concrete subfloors and electric underfloor heating, this tray is a professional-grade, ready-to-install wet room solution.

product.name: Alpine  Dual Fuel Heated Towel Rail, Anthracite - W500 x H1200 mm
product.description: Tired of your cold bathroom? Fed up of your towels taking ages to dry? Are they still damp the next morning? This heated towel rail is perfect for bathrooms, kitchens and drying rooms. The Alpine has been designed to efficiently provide heating and be pleasing to the eye. It’s always important not to let style comprise practicality. We’ve designed the Alpine to facilitate larger towels by carefully spacing the cross rails. Our Alpine towel offer undoubtable value for money and quality. Rigorously tested through ASTMB117 anti corrosive salt tested to 250 hours to ensure this towel rail is built to last. We back this by putting a 10-year guarantee onto the Alpine. The duel fuel kit consists of a CP Electric Element and Radiator Valves. It will enable you to switch between heating the towel rail via the central heating system to electric, which saves money in the summer months.  CP elements provide remarkable heat while also being up to 20% more efficient to run than standard elements.

product.name: Plum&Clay Corwin Horizontal Radiator Rustic Copper Triple Column Traditional Cast Iron Style Radiator (W)785mm (H)300mm
product.description:
The Corwin radiator is a traditional style masterpiece that effortlessly combines timeless elegance with modern functionality. Inspired by the conic cast iron radiators, this horizontal wonder is here to revolutionise your space with its classic charm.

With a triple column design and made from high quality mild steel, Corwin guarantees an exceptional heat output, ensuring your room stays cozy and warm even on the coldest of days.

With its traditional columns and cast iron look, this radiator pays homage to the timeless designs that came before it. Finished in a rustic copper colour, this classic touch adds a touch of refinement to any interior, effortlessly blending in with both contemporary and traditional decor.

To complete the traditional style, optional radiator feet are available to purchase separately.

Standard ½ inch pipe threads have been used for easy installation with most radiator valves.

Please note: As the rustic copper finish is applied by hand, slight variations in colour and appearance may occur, giving each radiator its own unique character.

Please note that radiator valves are not included with this product, allowing you the flexibility to choose valves that suit your preferences.
